briefing.text: Sector attention on the last full day (Nov 15) was led by Information Technology on all three platforms: news buzz 82.4 (-0.1 vs the day before, -5.3 over the week; NVDA, MSFT, AMD), X 93.0 (flat; NVDA, MU, AMD) and Reddit 93.5 (-0.4, mentions -12%; NVDA, AAPL, MSFT). On news, Energy rose most (buzz +6.2, mentions +33%, sentiment 0.36; FANG, CVX, KMI) followed by Materials (+4.6, mentions +55%; CCJ, NEM), while Financials slipped (-1.7, -14.0 on the week; UBS, BAC). On Reddit, Health Care climbed to rank 6 (+2.7, mentions +36%; NVO, LLY) and Real Estate mentions jumped 80% (buzz +2.1). On X, Communication Services moved up to rank 2 (buzz 90.8; NBIS, GOOGL, META), while the small Healthcare group fell 13.9 on a single ticker (VVVV).

KDP #1: only a routine analyst-rating note (Moderate Buy); it does not explain the rank, which comes from attention and X buzz.
LUV #2: airline news around weekend FAA disruption (American hit hardest, sentiment -0.93) and a Delta comparison; sector-wide, so it partly explains the jump from #13.
KLAR #3: CFO appointment (Chris Koegel from Jan 1, 2027); earnings are due Nov 17, which fits the high rank.
SHAK #4: a Kahn Brothers holding note and a newsletter mention; minor, does not explain the rank.
HD #5: 42 articles, mostly on earnings Nov 17 ("could swing $15.5 billion"); this explains the rise from #10.
PM #6: an institutional holding increase and a piece on higher rates testing dividend defensives; mild context only.
AFRM #7: fund letters praising the stock (4 positive of 5 articles); supportive but not a catalyst.
TAP #8: analyst consensus "Reduce" and a Fevertree item; does not explain the rank.

KDP ranks first on attention 1.49x normal and X attention 2.18x normal (97.9th and 100th percentile); volume is below normal (0.37) and the price move is small (0.7 sigma), with no catalyst flagged. LUV is second on attention 1.43x and X attention 1.60x, a 1.2-sigma price move (+3.3%) and a KPI market resolving soon; volume is low at 0.29. KLAR is third with the strongest volume of the three (1.43x normal, 99th percentile), X attention 1.96x and earnings on Nov 17, which makes it the only top-3 name tagged T1. All three are driven mainly by X and overall attention rather than trading volume.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
